Static capture adapter enforces new output, fresh context, bounded readiness/actions, origin guard, ambient animations allowed and phase/provenance records. CAPTURED denotes raw collection only. Adapter implementation is not HBC behavior or target architecture; not executed.

Static manifest utility checks file closure, bytes/hash, JSON/image structure and local links, with explicit semantic/visual/rights limits. Structural PASS cannot certify product meaning. Seal/write helpers not executed against frozen evidence.

Static shared probe measures bounded visible DOM/style/image/environment/media signals; no context creation, worker/closed-shadow/cross-origin inspection or rendered-font proof. These are evidence limits, not an HBC requirement to choose a renderer; not executed.

Static source report uses substring scans including comments and bounded local map parsing; availability/tokens/nonempty mappings cannot prove runtime use or bundle correspondence. No fetch, endpoint guessing or execution undertaken.

Static helper tests cover schema/readiness/provenance/closure and optional synthetic-browser pages. Unexecuted assertions and generic examples cannot create HBC acceptance results; no test run or application change authorized by their presence.
